names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 28 Φεβρουαρίου, «Οσίες Μαράνα και Κύρα», with the rank word left off.

The heading of the calendar’s own name link behind the day’s line, «Марина Берийская (Македонская), дева, затворница, прп.», with the rank words left off; the parentheses are the page’s own. The day’s line names the two sisters together and in the genitive — «Прпп. жен Марины и Киры».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 февраля ст. ст. — «Прпп. жен Марины и Киры (ок. 450).»

attestations.note: The calendar spells her name «Марина», not Марана, and the line and the name page agree on it; the form is recorded as the calendar prints it and the folder’s English display name is not changed, because the line keeps her with her sister and on the day and at the year this folder already holds. Two readings disagree and neither is acted on: the calendar puts the sisters in Beria of Asia Minor in the fourth century, where this folder’s Greek source puts them at Beroea of Syria at the beginning of the fifth. `dates` is untouched — the calendar’s own «(ок. 450)» and its «жили в IV веке» do not agree with each other either.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Οσίες Μαράνα και Κύρα»

attestations.note: Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).

floruit.note: saint.gr: «Οι Οσίες Κύρα και Μαράνα κατάγονταν από τη Βέρροια (τωρινό Χαλέπιο) της Συρίας και έζησαν στις αρχές του 5ου αιώνα μ.Χ.». The page gives no year.
